$help: Every word of the emails the site's forms cause. mail/render.js fills the tokens in braces: {product} {email} {name} {company} {role} {time} {kitName} {count} {missing} {replyTo}.

The sender reads this file from GitHub on every request, so a saved change applies within a minute. Preview any change first: node tools/mail-preview.js --sample, then open .work/mail-preview/index.html.
Rules the checker holds: no em dashes; an artifact name at most 24 characters and its use line at most 95; the walkthrough is called "Interactive demo".
